text: Drip irrigation is the recommended watering method for commercial cucumber: it saves labor, delivers water precisely to the root zone, allows fertilizer to be fed through the same line (fertigation), avoids wasting water on non-root areas, and creates conditions less favorable to some diseases compared to overhead watering. A standard drip line (P1) has 16mm outer diameter, drip emitters spaced 20cm apart each delivering about 2.1 liters/hour at 1 bar pressure, with one roll covering about 1,000 m². Two setup options exist: (1) pressurized delivery direct from a water pump, or (2) gravity-fed from an elevated water tank/drum.
